opening.text: Think of the last time you were afraid, sick, or lost. What did you need most? Often it is not advice. It is someone steady to put a hand on your head and say, God knows you. That is a priesthood blessing. It is God's love, spoken through one of His servants.

mainMessage.text: Priesthood blessings are a gift from God. They bring comfort, direction and healing, and they are open to every member.

blocks.text: **The purpose is to bless** The priesthood exists to bless others in the Lord's name. Peter gave what he had, and it was enough.
The Lord bless thee, and keep thee: The Lord make his face shine upon thee, and be gracious unto thee: The Lord lift up his countenance upon thee, and give thee peace.

Then Peter said, Silver and gold have I none; but such as I have give I thee: In the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth rise up and walk. And he took him by the right hand, and lifted him up: and immediately his feet and ankle bones received strength.
President Henry B. Eyring, Second Counselor in the First Presidency, said this in his talk “Bless in His Name” from the April 2021 general conference.
The purpose for our receiving the priesthood is to allow us to bless people for the Lord, doing so in His name.
A blessing is never about the one giving it.
**A pattern for the sick** The scriptures show how to ask for a blessing. Call for the elders. They pray and anoint with oil.

Is any sick among you? let him call for the elders of the church; and let them pray over him, anointing him with oil in the name of the Lord: And the prayer of faith shall save the sick, and the Lord shall raise him up; and if he have committed sins, they shall be forgiven him.
Elder Dallin H. Oaks of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles said this in his talk “Healing the Sick” from the April 2010 general conference.
Miracles happen when the authority of the priesthood is used to bless the sick.
You are allowed to ask. You do not have to wait for a crisis.
**Faith matters** Jesus took the hand of a young girl and told her to rise. Faith is part of every healing.

And he took the damsel by the hand, and said unto her, Talitha cumi; which is, being interpreted, Damsel, I say unto thee, arise. And straightway the damsel arose, and walked; for she was of the age of twelve years. And they were astonished with a great astonishment.
Elder Dallin H. Oaks of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles said this in his talk “Healing the Sick” from the April 2010 general conference.
Faith is essential for healing by the powers of heaven.
Faith does not always mean certainty. It means trust.
**Blessings of direction** Not every blessing is about illness. A father may bless his children for guidance or courage. Jacob did this for his grandsons.

And he blessed Joseph, and said, God, before whom my fathers Abraham and Isaac did walk, the God which fed me all my life long unto this day, The Angel which redeemed me from all evil, bless the lads; and let my name be named on them, and the name of my fathers Abraham and Isaac; and let them grow into a multitude in the midst of the earth.
President Henry B. Eyring, Second Counselor in the First Presidency, said this in his talk “Bless in His Name” from the April 2021 general conference.
I always pray to know what blessing the Lord has in store that I can give in His name.
The giver listens before he speaks.
**The Lord's will, not ours** A blessing does not promise the result we expect. It places the outcome in the Lord's hands.

And whosoever among you are sick, and have not faith to be healed, but believe, shall be nourished with all tenderness, with herbs and mild food, and that not by the hand of an enemy. And the elders of the church, two or more, shall be called, and shall pray for and lay their hands upon them in my name; and if they die they shall die unto me, and if they live they shall live unto me.
Elder Dallin H. Oaks of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles said this in his talk “Healing the Sick” from the April 2010 general conference.
Fortunately, the words spoken in a healing blessing are not essential to its healing effect.
The power is God's. The words are only the channel.
**Open to you** You can ask. You do not need a special occasion or a perfect life.
Fear thou not; for I am with thee: be not dismayed; for I am thy God: I will strengthen thee; yea, I will help thee; yea, I will uphold thee with the right hand of my righteousness.
Laudy Ruth Kaouk Alvarez, a member of the Slate Canyon 14th Ward, said this in her talk “How the Priesthood Blesses Youth” from the April 2020 general conference.
Regardless of your circumstances, you can always have access to priesthood blessings.
If you need one, ask.

story.title: Naaman is healed

blocks.text: Naaman had leprosy. The prophet told him to wash in the Jordan seven times. At first Naaman was angry, but he did it.

And Elisha sent a messenger unto him, saying, Go and wash in Jordan seven times, and thy flesh shall come again to thee, and thou shalt be clean. Then went he down, and dipped himself seven times in Jordan, according to the saying of the man of God: and his flesh came again like unto the flesh of a little child, and he was clean.
The instruction was simple. Obedience brought the miracle. When we follow the Lord's simple ways, He can heal.

Then Peter said, Silver and gold have I none; but such as I have give I thee: In the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth rise up and walk. And he took him by the right hand, and lifted him up: and immediately his feet and ankle bones received strength.
President Henry B. Eyring, Second Counselor in the First Presidency, said this in his talk “Bless in His Name” from the April 2021 general conference.
The purpose for our receiving the priesthood is to allow us to bless people for the Lord, doing so in His name.

Is any sick among you? let him call for the elders of the church; and let them pray over him, anointing him with oil in the name of the Lord: And the prayer of faith shall save the sick, and the Lord shall raise him up; and if he have committed sins, they shall be forgiven him.

And he took the damsel by the hand, and said unto her, Talitha cumi; which is, being interpreted, Damsel, I say unto thee, arise. And straightway the damsel arose, and walked; for she was of the age of twelve years. And they were astonished with a great astonishment.

**Words for your life** Blessings can also give counsel for a hard decision or a new challenge.

And he blessed Joseph, and said, God, before whom my fathers Abraham and Isaac did walk, the God which fed me all my life long unto this day, The Angel which redeemed me from all evil, bless the lads; and let my name be named on them, and the name of my fathers Abraham and Isaac; and let them grow into a multitude in the midst of the earth.
President Henry B. Eyring, Second Counselor in the First Presidency, said this in his talk “Bless in His Name” from the April 2021 general conference.

And the elders of the church, two or more, shall be called, and shall pray for and lay their hands upon them in my name; and if they die they shall die unto me, and if they live they shall live unto me.
Elder Dallin H. Oaks of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles said this in his talk “Healing the Sick” from the April 2010 general conference.
Fortunately, the words spoken in a healing blessing are not essential to its healing effect.
In the Lord's hands, either outcome is a mercy.
**For all of us** No matter your age or situation, you can call for a blessing. The promise is that God is with you.
Fear thou not; for I am with thee: be not dismayed; for I am thy God: I will strengthen thee; yea, I will help thee; yea, I will uphold thee with the right hand of my righteousness.
Laudy Ruth Kaouk Alvarez, a member of the Slate Canyon 14th Ward, said this in her talk “How the Priesthood Blesses Youth” from the April 2020 general conference.
Regardless of your circumstances, you can always have access to priesthood blessings.
You are never too far to ask.

story.title: A woman touches His garment

blocks.text: A woman had been ill for twelve years. She had no strength to ask out loud. She reached out in faith.

And, behold, a woman, which was diseased with an issue of blood twelve years, came behind him, and touched the hem of his garment: For she said within herself, If I may but touch his garment, I shall be whole. But Jesus turned him about, and when he saw her, he said, Daughter, be of good comfort; thy faith hath made thee whole. And the woman was made whole from that hour.
Sometimes faith is quiet. Jesus Christ saw her and called her daughter. He sees us the same way.

story.title: Bartimaeus asks for sight

blocks.text: A blind man called out to Jesus. Jesus stopped and asked what he wanted.

And Jesus answered and said unto him, What wilt thou that I should do unto thee? The blind man said unto him, Lord, that I might receive my sight. And Jesus said unto him, Go thy way; thy faith hath made thee whole. And immediately he received his sight, and followed Jesus in the way.
Bartimaeus asked plainly. Jesus Christ listens when we ask plainly too. A blessing is one way we ask.

story.title: Jesus heals at sunset

blocks.text: At the end of a long day, people brought their sick to Jesus.
Now when the sun was setting, all they that had any sick with divers diseases brought them unto him; and he laid his hands on every one of them, and healed them.
He did not turn them away, though it was late and He was tired. He gave each one His touch. We follow His pattern when we lay hands on a person in need.

story.title: Come unto Me

blocks.text: Jesus gave a simple invitation to anyone who was tired.
Come unto me, all ye that labour and are heavy laden, and I will give you rest.
He does not ask us to be strong first. He asks us to come. A priesthood blessing is one way we come to Him.
